cases.query: What exemption applies to older Class I widgets, and where is it defined?
cases.answer: Exemption C applies to widgets manufactured before January 2023, allowing an 85% threshold instead of 95%, as defined in Section 4 of the Handbook.
cases.reviewer_notes: Demonstrates the cross-reference diagnostic: 'Section 4' resolves to a packed segment (no warning); 'Exemption C' is a body-text phrase, not a heading, so it does not match any segment location and reports UNKNOWN (see docs/cross-reference-diagnostic-spec.md's location-text-heuristic limitation).

cases.query: What must a manufacturer show for eligibility, and what threshold must a Class I widget pass?
cases.answer: A manufacturer is eligible for Standard Certification if it has held a valid Facility Registration for at least 12 months, and a Class I widget must pass the Load Stress Test at a 95% threshold.
